text: There is at least one new Studio Display
full-pick-text: There is at least one new Studio Display. At least one model features a Mini LED display with a 90hz refresh rate. Apple will create a new name to describe this panel (like Liquid Retina XDR). The old Studio Display and Pro Display XDR are still available
